name: Wispra Pixel
author: wispra

sections.description:
The Wispra Pixel plugin allows you to easily integrate the Wispra tracking pixel into your WordPress website. Simply enter your Wispra Pixel ID in the settings, and the plugin will handle the rest, injecting the necessary JavaScript code into your site’s header.

Features:

  • Simple configuration: Just paste your Pixel ID.
  • Lightweight: Adds minimal code to your site.
  • Secure: Sanitizes input to prevent security issues.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Wispra API to load tracking and analytics metadata. This connection is necessary for the Wispra Pixel to function properly and provide website analytics.

What data is sent:
The plugin sends the visitor’s user-agent string to the Wispra API every time a page is loaded on your website (when the Wispra Pixel is active).

When data is sent:
Data is transmitted on every page load to retrieve the appropriate tracking metadata for your configured Pixel ID.

Service provider:

– Privacy Policy: https://wispra.fr/politique-confidentialite/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wispra-pixel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘Wispra Pixel’ and enter your Pixel ID.
  4. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Wispra Pixel ID?

You can find your Pixel ID in your Wispra dashboard under the integration settings. It usually looks like a UUID (e.g., 9e656372-5bf3-4ec1-8204-c6d7a436c0bd).

Does this plugin affect site performance?

The plugin injects a very small asynchronous script, so the impact on performance is negligible.
